About us

Barbering built
on Kenyan hands

Dixit Trims opened as a two-chair kiosk and grew into a full floor because regulars kept sending their brothers, their sons, their bosses. We still cut the way we started — unhurried, exact, and finished with a hot towel, not a rush out the door.

Our barbers trained across Nairobi's busiest shops before landing here, and every one of them can talk you through a fade, a beard line, or the safest bet if you genuinely have no idea what you want.

R.D.
Ravi Dixit
Founder & head barber
